entities.name: François Méthot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: François Méthot is a Canadian ice hockey coach and former player. He is the current head coach of the Rochester Jr. Americans of the North American Hockey League (NAHL). He was the Buffalo Sabres' third pick, 54th overall, in the 1996 NHL Entry Draft from the Shawinigan Cataractes, but only ever played exhibition games in the NHL.
